findings.summary: the mandate cannot pass the terminal gate: exit multiple 21.5x with WACC 13.54% and terminal growth 2.50% gives a terminal-value ratio of at least 3.09 even at EBIT/EBITDA 95%, above the gate limit 3.0x. Under this WACC and growth the exit multiple can be at most 20.9x
findings.required_evidence: a mandate whose exit multiple, WACC and terminal growth can reconcile within the gate limit

note: input for an evolution proposal: each finding names a defect in the harness (system) or a human-owned input (mandate) that no role can repair
